correctness.rationale: Every permitted one-step change in a finite partial matching has been enumerated, and the exact creation/deletion ratio and symmetry of rewiring prove detailed balance. Irreducibility gives uniqueness. Counting ordered disjoint cut edges gives all falling-factorial moments and the full polynomial. A strictly concave Stirling saddle for the exact pair-count distribution yields mean and variance limits; direct conditional-factorial moments yield the cut-variance coefficient and sharp Fano inequality. The included standalone checker passed 74,636 deterministic assertions covering exact kernels for N=4..8 and asymptotic samples N=1000,3000,6000. Numerics are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The observable is the central trajectory-wise entanglement entropy in the originating physical model. Exact all-N distribution and sharp macroscopic shot-noise suppression give information about fluctuations not available from the published mean or phase diagram. The identification of exact reversible equilibrium dynamics under repeated quantum measurement is structural, and the closed partition-dependent Fano frontier identifies the most variable macroscopic cut.
